about_the_game: RED ALERT! A rampaging army of rogue robots is throwing the planet into chaos! Take control of high-powered ships in a mind-blowing 3D universe and push back the enemy... beyond the atmosphere! Blast through over 10 adrenaline-fueled levels packed with action, secrets, and epic set pieces. Pull off daring maneuvers, uncover hidden puzzles, and take down titanic bosses in all-out battles for survival! Challenge accepted?
